finding_goc.finding_title: UnsafeReserve: Silent overflow when casting large reserve amount
finding_goc.finding_description: The `record(uint256 amount)` function stores user-provided `amount` directly into `reserve` which is of type `uint128`. When `amount` exceeds `2^128 - 1`, the cast silently truncates the high bits, causing `reserve` to store an incorrect value. There is no check before the cast.
